d: Youth-led protests over rising living costs have turned violent across Europe, with demonstrations reported in Germany, Switzerland, France and Portugal. In Germany, Gen Z protesters looted shops in Frankfurt as tens of thousands took to the streets across 34 cities. In Zurich, demonstrators set vehicles on fire and clashed with police. France witnessed its third consecutive weekend of cost-of-living protests, with 320,000 people marching and police deploying tear gas after protesters allegedly hurled Molotov cocktails. In Lisbon, police used batons and tear gas to clear a housing protest…
